k.q: Predict the exact output of this OCR ERL program, change one value, then extend the program.
k.code:
height = 145
if height >= 140 then
    print("Tall enough")
endif
print("Checked")
p: Predict the output of the supplied code.
Change height to 130 and predict both lines.
Add an else branch that prints "Too short" for values below 140.
k.a:
Original output: Tall enough, then Checked.

After the changes: At 130: Checked. With else: Too short and Checked.
